title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social spaces, cultural events, and recreational activities at Agnes Scott College that require no admission or purchase.

cards.title: Stargazing Open House
cards.subtitle: Monthly Astronomy Events
cards.notes: Attend free monthly open houses featuring lectures, planetarium shows, and telescope viewings. Events are open to the public during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: Free monthly astronomy lectures and telescope viewings at the campus observatory.
cards.evidence_claim: For 70 years, Bradley Observatory has welcomed guests to our open houses monthly during the academic year. The event is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Open House Series - Agnes Scott College
cards.access_notes: Open one Friday evening per month at 7 p.m. or 8 p.m. during the semester.

cards.title: Contemporary Art Viewing
cards.subtitle: Dana Fine Arts Building
cards.notes: Explore rotating contemporary art exhibitions in this teaching gallery. Admission is free for students and the general public to view diverse visual works.
cards.short_summary: A free campus art gallery hosting rotating exhibitions and student-focused visual literacy programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dalton Gallery operates as a teaching gallery... Exhibitions engage with on campus conversations. Admission is free.
cards.source_title: The Dalton Gallery: About Dalton Gallery
cards.access_notes: Located in the Dana Fine Arts Building; check gallery website for current exhibition hours.

cards.title: Self-Guided Tree Tour
cards.subtitle: Campus-Wide Nature Walk
cards.notes: Follow a self-guided tour of over 40 historic trees across 100 acres. Use QR codes on plaques to learn about the biology and history of the campus canopy.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided botanical tour featuring historic trees and QR-coded educational plaques.
cards.evidence_claim: The tour, which includes more than 40 historic trees on Agnes Scott's beautiful tree-lined campus, covers topics ranging from history and biology to sustainability.
cards.access_notes: Accessible outdoors across the campus grounds at any time.

cards.title: Historic Library Study
cards.subtitle: Public Access Research Space
cards.notes: Study in a historic architectural setting. The library offers free visitor access and a visitor log for those using the physical collections and quiet spaces.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus library providing free study space and research access for visitors.
cards.evidence_claim: Library privileges extended to alumnae, visitors and other 'guest users' from the general public... Please sign in and out the Visitor Log.
cards.access_notes: Visitor hours: Mon-Thu 10AM-7PM, Fri 10AM-6PM, Sat 10AM-4PM, Sun 4PM-7PM. Restricted during exams.

cards.title: Free Music Concerts
cards.subtitle: Department of Music Events
cards.notes: Enjoy free performances by student ensembles and guest artists. Most concerts are held in Maclean Auditorium or Gaines Chapel and require no tickets.
cards.short_summary: Regularly scheduled free musical performances open to the campus and local community.
cards.evidence_claim: All Music Department concerts and events are free and open to the public unless otherwise noted. No ticket necessary.
cards.source_title: Upcoming Music Events - Agnes Scott College
cards.access_notes: Check the music department calendar for specific event dates and times.

cards.title: Open Lap Swimming
cards.subtitle: Olympic-Sized Pool Access
cards.notes: Students can use the Olympic-sized pool for lap swimming during designated open hours. Access is free with a valid student ID card.
cards.short_summary: Free lap swimming for students at the campus athletic complex pool.
cards.evidence_claim: Open swim hours are available for students who want to stay in shape with lap swimming... offered to Agnes Scott students free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Requires student ID; check the athletics website for current open swim schedules.

cards.title: Student Social Lounges
cards.subtitle: Commuter and Student Spaces
cards.notes: Relax or meet friends in the dedicated student lounges. These spaces provide comfortable seating and a social atmosphere for all Scotties between classes.
cards.short_summary: Central campus hub featuring free social lounges and meeting spaces for students.
cards.evidence_claim: We can make your life a little easier by providing you with lounges specifically for you in the Alston Campus Center.
cards.source_title: Commuter Student Information | Agnes Scott College
cards.access_notes: Open daily for student use; specific rooms like 114 offer workout spaces.

cards.title: Free Equipment Checkout
cards.subtitle: Bikes, Hammocks, and Games
cards.notes: Borrow bicycles, hammocks, frisbees, and lawn games for free. The checkout program encourages students to enjoy the campus outdoors without buying gear.
cards.short_summary: A free rental program for students to borrow outdoor recreation and sports equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: We offer a free recreational equipment checkout program to all students. Reserve bicycles, hammocks, Frisbees...
cards.source_title: ASC Campus Recreation - Agnes Scott College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Visit room 213 in the Woodruff Athletics Center to check out equipment with a student ID.

cards.title: Weekly Quad Yoga
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Wellness Classes
cards.notes: Join free weekly yoga sessions held on the main quad. These classes are open to the entire campus community and focus on relaxation and wellness.
cards.short_summary: Free weekly outdoor yoga classes for students and staff on the central campus lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: Bring your mat to the main quad where yoga is offered once a week to the entire Agnes Scott community... free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Held once a week; weather permitting. Check Campus Recreation for the current schedule.

cards.title: Scale Model Solar System
cards.subtitle: Interactive Science Plaza
cards.notes: Walk through a scale model of the solar system at this interactive outdoor plaza. It features interpretive signage and demonstrates the relative sizes of planets.
cards.short_summary: An educational outdoor plaza featuring a scale model of the solar system and astronomical markers.
cards.evidence_claim: Outside the observatory is an interactive plaza... It features the Metro-Atlanta Scale Model Solar System (MASS) Project.
cards.source_title: The Bradley Observatory in Decatur holds its FREE open house - Atlanta on the Cheap
cards.access_notes: Open public outdoor space located adjacent to the Bradley Observatory.
